paper: Pair density wave, charge density wave and vortex in high Tc cuprates
authors: Zhehao Dai, Ya-Hui Zhang, T. Senthil, Patrick A. Lee
CLASS_MISLABEL_NOTE: This paper is NOT a kagome loop-current / orbital-current order theory. It is a cuprate pair-density-wave (PDW) / charge-density-wave (CDW) vortex-halo phenomenology paper. Loop currents appear ONLY as a one-line citation (intra-cell magnetic moments interpreted as orbital loop currents, ref 6,7) in the introduction, not as the physics of the paper. The assigned kernel (loop_current_meanfield_kernel.py, a kagome Peierls-flux probe) is the WRONG model for this paper. Per the replication-execution mislabel guard, we replicate the paper's ACTUAL minimal model and testable headline, and credit the kernel only for methodological provenance (density-matrix / real-space order-parameter machinery).
method: Phenomenological Landau + real-space order-parameter construction near a superconducting vortex core, cross-checked in the paper by exact diagonalization of a BdG lattice model (Appendix B).
model_system: 2D cuprate CuO2 plane with a single d-wave superconducting vortex. A bi-directional pair density wave (PDW) with momenta +/-Q_x, +/-Q_y (period 4pi/Q ~ 8a) is phase-locked to the d-wave order parameter by the 2pi phase winding around the vortex core. The PDW induces subsidiary charge-density-wave (CDW) orders at Q/2 (period 8) and Q (period 4).

key_params.d_wave_profile: Delta_D(r,theta) = |Delta_D| * r/sqrt(r^2+r0^2) * e^{i theta}, vortex core size r0 = 3.5a
key_params.PDW_profile: Delta_P(r) ~ exp(1 - sqrt(r^2+xi^2)/xi), correlation length xi = 15a
key_params.PDW_period: 4pi/Q ~ 8a  (Q/2 CDW is period 8, Q CDW is period 4)
key_params.regime: 4pi/Q ~ xi_P > rcore (opposite of usual slowly-varying Landau limit)
key_params.phase_pinning: phi_x = phi_y = -pi/2 pinned by overlap-integral maximization; theta_{P,x}=theta_d, theta_{P,y}=pi/2+theta_d

headline_claim: In the PDW-driven scenario, the induced period-8 (Q/2) CDW order parameter inherits the 2pi phase winding of the d-wave order, giving a real-space amplitude proportional to cos(theta - theta_a). This angular factor produces (i) a LINE OF ZEROS through the vortex core in real space, and (ii) a SPLITTING of the Fourier-transform peak at q = Q_a/2 into two peaks (split ~ 1/xi) in the direction set by theta_a, plus a sign change / zero of Re(nu-tilde) at q = Q_a/2 along the perpendicular cut. In the CDW-driven scenario the Q/2 peak is a SINGLE unsplit peak. This split-peak signature is the proposed experimental discriminator between PDW-driven and CDW-driven period-8 order.
testable_headline_for_replication: Construct the PDW-driven Q/2 CDW real-space field rho(r) = F(r) cos(theta - theta_a) cos(Q_a . r + phi_a) with the paper's F(r) built from the d-wave and PDW profiles. FFT it. VERIFY: (1) the PDW-driven field shows a SPLIT double peak at |q| ~ Q_a/2 with splitting ~ 1/xi along theta_a; (2) the CDW-driven field rho = Fc(r) cos(Q_a.r) shows a SINGLE peak; (3) real-space line of zeros along theta = theta_a +/- pi/2; (4) sign change of Re(FFT) across q = Q_a/2 on the perpendicular cut.
observable: FFT peak structure at Q/2: number of peaks (2 for PDW-driven vs 1 for CDW-driven) and peak splitting delta_q; presence of real-space nodal line; Re(FFT) sign change.
replication_difficulty: low-medium -- the paper's proposed discriminator is an analytic real-space construction + FFT, directly reproducible on a coarse 2D grid in <1 min. Full BdG exact diagonalization (Appendix B) is heavier and out of scope for the fast probe; we reproduce the phenomenological headline, which is the paper's central experimental prediction.
provenance_kernel: loop_current_meanfield_kernel.py (Ollie) -- credited for density-matrix / real-space order-parameter methodology; NOT directly applicable (kagome tight-binding) so a from-scratch PDW/CDW vortex model is built.
